The adjective right after the adverb and the final subword of a multi-token surname or brand ('Ne|al', 'K|ering', 'Future|wise') get weaker activity. It stays inactive (below 0.25 of max) on plain predicative sentences about concrete things with no amplifier ('The water was cold.', 'The dog chased the cat into the garden.'). Non-amplifying adverbs such as ' too', ' not', ' also', ' still', ' all' and colour or material adjectives are also inactive, as are determiners, concrete nouns and word-initial name fragments.
